title: Fluxygram diagram
description: An animated diagram that explains something step by step.

type.description: Diagram type. Each one has its own default motion.

title.description: Shown above the diagram. Say what it shows.

groups.description: Layers for architecture diagrams, listed top to bottom.

steps.description: Optional story. Steps are cumulative. Without steps, the type's default motion is used.

finale.description: After the last step the camera zooms out and every visible connection flows at once. Set false to end on the last step.

motion.description: Default animation for the whole diagram. Blocks and connections can override enter / travel.

enter.description: How a block enters. fade: fades up (default). scale: grows with a slight bounce. draw: its outline is traced, then fill and text appear. slide: slides in.

travel.description: What travels along a connection when it flows. particle: comet dot (default). pulse: a stretch of light. dash: dashes marching continuously. packets: small spaced blocks.

camera.description: follow: the camera follows the action. fixed: everything always in view.

hold.description: Seconds each step stays on screen during autoplay. Omit it to let Fluxygram time each step by its content.

description.description: One short line under the name.

kind.description: Block shape. decision: diamond (phrase it as a question). start/end: pill. data: parallelogram (input/output). database: cylinder. note: folded note for annotations.

group.description: architecture only: the layer this node belongs to.

accent.description: Highlight this node with the accent color.

x.description: Manually pinned position (top-left), set by the visual editor. Omit it to let Fluxygram place the node.

y.description: Manually pinned position (top-left). Use together with x.

enter.description: How a block enters. fade: fades up (default). scale: grows with a slight bounce. draw: its outline is traced, then fill and text appear. slide: slides in.

state.description: State from the start (steps can change it). success: green + check. error: red, shakes. warning: amber, badge blinks. pending: in progress, dashed border spins.

id.description: Needed to reference the edge from steps. Defaults to "from->to".

carries.description: What travels along the edge. Shown next to the particle ("token", "$", "event"). 1 or 2 words.

travel.description: What travels along a connection when it flows. particle: comet dot (default). pulse: a stretch of light. dash: dashes marching continuously. packets: small spaced blocks.

state.description: State from the start. Colors the line, the particle and the label (e.g. a path that fails).

show.description: Elements that appear. Showing an edge also shows its two nodes.

focus.description: The camera moves in on this node or group.

flow.description: Edges a particle travels along while the step is active.

highlight.description: Elements that stand out; the rest dims.

caption.description: Text for the step. Keep it under 12 words.

state.description: Changes node or connection states from this step on: { "pay": "success", "e3": "error" }. "default" clears it.

duration.description: Seconds this step stays on screen during autoplay (overrides motion.hold).

notes.description: Speaker notes for this step. Shown only in the presenter view (/present), never in the diagram.
